state.persona: Approved chalet operator with a PUBLISHED offer that already has two traveler inquiries. They fix a typo in the title and press 'Save draft'.
visible_before_save: Every offer leads to an inquiry, not a confirmed reservation. Updating a published offer returns it to draft for review.
visible_after_save: Status notice: Offer saved as a draft. Preview it below before publishing.
Offer card eyebrow: stay · Courchevel · draft
system_facts: The offer is now hidden from all travelers until the provider presses Publish again; there is no admin review step despite 'for review'.
Travelers who already asked see their request titled 'Your travel request' instead of the offer name while it is unpublished.
Pressing 'Delete draft' on this offer shows the raw database error: update or delete on table "offers" violates foreign key constraint "inquiries_offer_id_fkey" on table "inquiries".

realizes_unpublished.instructions: After saving, would the operator realize their offer is no longer visible to travelers?

expects_admin_review.instructions: Would the operator believe they must wait for a MERIDIAN review before republishing?

delete_error_recoverable.instructions: Would the operator understand the delete error and know how to recover?
